title: parse_attendees

spec.text: Parse an uploaded attendee CSV (header row: name,email,ticket) exported from Excel or Google Sheets. Skip blank lines and lowercase emails. Rows without an email go into errors as "line N: missing email", where N is the line number the organiser sees in the spreadsheet (header is line 1). An empty upload returns no attendees and no errors.

context: Called by the upload endpoint with the decoded file text. Spreadsheet exports quote fields that contain commas, e.g. "Tan, Wei Ming".
